PCMO WEBINAR VIDEO PRODUCTION SCRIPT
Series 1 - Webinar 01

TITLE: Why Project Management and Contracts Management Must Work Together
AUDIENCE: All professionals
OBJECTIVE: Introduce the PCMO philosophy of integrated project and contract delivery.

OPENING
Welcome to PCMO Series One: Project Management Fundamentals. In this webinar, we explore why project management and contracts management must work together.

SCENE 1 - WHY PROJECTS FAIL
Projects rarely fail because of one isolated technical problem. Misaligned scope, decisions, risk, obligations, records, cost, schedule, and relationships combine until recovery becomes difficult.

SCENE 2 - THE DANGER OF PM-CM SILOS
Project teams may focus on delivery while contract teams focus on rights and obligations. When their information and decisions separate, change is recognised late and commercial consequences are misunderstood.

SCENE 3 - AN INTEGRATED DELIVERY MODEL
Successful delivery connects scope, schedule, cost, risk, change, procurement, obligations, notices, records, forecasting, governance, and stakeholder decisions in one operating rhythm.

SCENE 4 - THE FUTURE PROFESSIONAL
Future-ready professionals understand both delivery and commercial context. They collaborate across disciplines, communicate uncertainty, preserve evidence, and make decisions that are practical and contract-aware.

CLOSING CALL TO ACTION
Download the Integrated PM-CM Career Roadmap from the PCMO Library and identify the next capability you need to build.

END CARD
